source_policy.rule: Every scenario uses the same clean post-review commit and source fingerprint; any scoped edit invalidates all earlier scenario evidence.

resources.walltime_basis: The retained 9-node 60-local-step by 20-global-step job completed inside 20 minutes. These 5-node scenarios use 20 local steps and 4 global steps; even takeover adds only a 15-second lease expiry and bounded 120-second fault wait. Ten minutes is the workflow minimum and retains more than twice the expected runtime plus teardown margin. Live qstat --rsc -x on 2026-08-10 showed debug-g enabled for 1-16 nodes with a 30-minute maximum; it is the appropriate brief multi-node validation queue after three regular-g submissions never started because of defaults or backfill reservations.

rules: Do not use qsub -V or place credentials in scheduler variables.
Use a unique create-only run root, log root, PBS stdout path and evidence path per scenario.
Submit the next scenario only after the prior job is terminal and its structured artifact has been classified.
A missing run prerequisite is BLOCKED; a malformed or semantically incorrect current run is FAIL. Neither is PASS.

durable_oracles: Exactly four learner identities and one syncer identity attest on the exact five PBS nodes.
Versions are exactly 0 through 4, every contributor supplies exactly four applied proposals, and selection credit is exactly four each.
Each applied proposal represents 20 optimizer steps and 320 tokens; direct applied weight is exactly 5120 tokens.

Total fault-free attempted cycles may exceed applied contributions because Full Protocol learners run asynchronously through supersession and terminal observation. Every receipt maps one-to-one to an exact-workload proposal; every non-applied proposal is durably dropped; dropped tokens equal processed minus applied; local discard, quarantine/conflict, reported-unpublished and outstanding totals are zero.
All contributor cursors equal durable receipt history, the token ledger balances to zero, and no pending update or prepared publication remains.
The sole syncer epoch is released, every contributor terminal fence is acknowledged, fixed and immutable terminal controls equal authority, publication hashes match, and SQLite integrity is ok.

injection.layer: learner process after learner_000 has at least one committed selection credit
injection.action: SIGTERM the first attempt, publish one exact static replacement authorization, then start the named successor attempt
injection.authority: static contributor binding generation and immutable replacement authorization

durable_oracles: learner_000 binding generation advances by exactly one; old history is terminal with final_status=replaced and the current attempt equals the registered successor.
The injected old process exit is nonzero, the successor contributes accepted work and reaches terminal acknowledgement.
Versions, exact 5120 direct applied tokens, contributor coverage, balanced ledger, terminal controls, publication hashes and SQLite integrity satisfy the common acceptance formulas.

injection.layer: syncer process immediately after committed version 2, outside a SQLite transaction and with the lease renewer quiesced
injection.action: publish the exact fault marker, SIGKILL the primary, wait for lease expiry, then run one successor candidate
injection.authority: strictly increasing SQLite leader epoch and fenced business-command transaction

durable_oracles: The fault marker proves committed_version=2, sqlite_transaction_active=false and lease_renewer_quiesced=true for the killed primary PID.
Epoch history is exactly expired then released, the first epoch links to the higher successor epoch, and the successor commits at least one publication.
No lower epoch commits at or after the successor's first version; there is one exact publication chain through version 4.
Exact 5120 direct applied tokens, contributor coverage, balanced ledger, terminal controls, publication hashes and SQLite integrity satisfy the common acceptance formulas.

artifact_policy.pass_rule: status is PASS, errors is empty, the scenario-specific durable oracles and all common identity/workload/terminal/integrity checks hold
artifact_policy.failure_rule: Preserve the structured FAIL/BLOCKED artifact, PBS stdout, log root and full run root until root cause and finding disposition are closed.
artifact_policy.success_retention: Track the structured artifact and minimal PBS/log manifest; preserve authority, descriptor, resolved config, terminal controls, attestations and publication identities through P3 review.
artifact_policy.cleanup: After P3 review, use only fs_diloco.tools.clean_run with the matching PASS artifact and an exact run root. Do not delete an entire run, live/resumable state, authority data, referenced publications or ownership-uncertain paths.
